<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=What Time Is the Train?|id=A0056}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
Don't panic! Take your time with this lesson! Not only are Liliana and JP talking about a lot of numbers but also about times and hours — including the funny 24-hour system. We learn that JP doesn't like it and even Liliana seems to get it wrong at one point. Anyway, the key phrases are: '''¿Qué hora es?''' – What time is it? and '''¡Apúrate!''' – Hurry up!
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0092|A0092: How old are you?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0112|A0112: What is your telephone number?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0122|A0122: Telephone card]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¿A qué hora sale nuestro tren?'''
| At what time does our train leave?
| '''A las tres de la tarde.'''
| At three o'clock in the afternoon.
| '''¿Y qué hora es?'''
| And what time is it?
| '''¡Son las dos cuarenta!'''
| It's two forty.
| '''¡Apúrate! ¡Corre!'''
| Hurry up! Run!
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¿A qué hora sale nuestro tren?'''
| At what time does our train leave?
| '''A las tres de la tarde.'''
| At three o'clock in the afternoon.
| '''¿Y qué hora es?'''
| And what time is it?
| '''¡Son las dos cuarenta!'''
| It's two forty.
| '''¡Apúrate! ¡Corre!'''
| Hurry up! Run!
}}</includeonly>

{{SbcNewline2}}{{SbcNewline2}}<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| What time is it?
| '''¿Qué hora es?'''
| It's one o'clock.
| '''Es la una.'''
| And at what time does the train leave?
| '''¿Y a qué hora sale el tren?'''
| Our train leaves at three o'clock in the afternoon.
| '''Nuestro tren sale a las tres de la tarde.'''
| Hurry up! Run! ''(speaking to a watch)'' 
| '''¡Apúrate! ¡Corre!'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| What time is it?
| '''¿Qué hora es?'''
| It's one o'clock.
| '''Es la una.'''
| And at what time does the train leave?
| '''¿Y a qué hora sale el tren?'''
| Our train leaves at three o'clock in the afternoon.
| '''Nuestro tren sale a las tres de la tarde.'''
| Hurry up! Run! ''(speaking to a watch)'' 
| '''¡Apúrate! ¡Corre!'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the [[#More Vocabulary|More Vocabulary]] section.
{{SbcQuestion
| At what time does your train leave? (formal, singular)
| '''¿A qué hora sale su tren?'''
| At five o'clock in the afternoon.
| '''A las cinco de la tarde.'''
| And what time is it?
| '''¿Y qué hora es?'''
| It's four forty.
| '''¡Son las cuatro cuarenta!'''
| Hurry up! Run! (formal, singular)
| '''¡Apúrese! ¡Corra!'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recast====
